summary: Hydro One Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting that its subsidiary Hydro One Inc. priced an inaugural US$1.0 billion offering of 4.750% senior notes due 2031. The notes are unsecured, ranking equally with existing senior unsecured debt. Proceeds will repay maturing long-term debt, commercial paper, and for general corporate purposes. Joint book-runners are Barclays, Mizuho, and RBC. The US public offering is under an F-10 shelf registration via the multijurisdictional disclosure system. This is a routine debt financing — not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other special-situation event is present.
